chunks: It has been narrated: “For those who are not residents of Makkah, tawaf is better than salat (prayer), while salat (prayer) is better for the residents of Makkah.”
And whoever was with a group and watched over their belongings until they completed tawaf or sa'y, had the greatest reward among them.

key_terms.أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ: The residents or people of Makkah
key_terms.الطَّوَافَ: Circumambulation of the Ka'bah as an act of worship
key_terms.رِحْلَهُمْ: Their baggage or belongings during travel
key_terms.يَسْعَوْا: To perform sa'y between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.يَطُوفُوا: To perform tawaf around the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: Is tawaf better than salat (prayer) for non-residents of Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a distinction in merit between tawaf and salat (prayer) based on whether a person is from Makkah or not. It also teaches that serving pilgrims by guarding their belongings during tawaf or sa'y carries immense reward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2158 - It has been narrated: "For those who are not residents of Makkah, performing Tawaf is better than prayer, while for the residents of Makkah, prayer is better."
